weather.rainfall_source: NOAA PSL CMAP (CPC Merged Analysis of Precipitation)
weather.rainfall_method: NOAA PSL CMAP (CPC Merged Analysis of Precipitation), 2.5° grid (monthly distribution) + local annual total

recommended_structures.description: A dedicated storage tank collects and stores harvested rooftop runoff for direct use in toilets, gardening, and non-potable purposes. Most cost-effective first step for any building.
recommended_structures.installation_notes: Install at ground level or underground. Connect to rooftop downpipes via first-flush diverter. Include overflow pipe to recharge pit.

recommended_structures.description: A soak pit (1m diameter, 1.5–2m deep) filled with gravel provides a simple low-cost solution for small rooftop areas, distributing water slowly into surrounding soil.
recommended_structures.installation_notes: Dig 1m diameter × 1.5m depth. Line sides with dry-brick or perforated concrete rings. Fill with 40mm stone aggregate. Cover with perforated slab.

recommended_structures.description: A recharge pit (1.5m × 1.5m × 2m) filled with gravel and sand filters allows harvested water to percolate directly into the groundwater table. Highly effective for shallow aquifers.
recommended_structures.installation_notes: Excavate 2m deep, fill with 0.5m gravel at bottom, 1m stone/brick, 0.5m sand. Install inlet pipe from tank overflow. Provide removable top cover for cleaning.

recommended_structures.description: A dedicated recharge well (200–300mm diameter, 10–30m deep) channels treated rooftop runoff directly into deeper aquifers. Ideal where surface soil has low permeability but deep aquifers are present.
recommended_structures.installation_notes: Drill 200–300mm bore to aquifer depth. Install casing with perforations. Connect via first-flush diverter → settling tank → filter media → well. Annual cleaning required.

mcda.method: Analytic Hierarchy Process (Saaty, 1980) — geometric mean weights, consistency-checked

recommended_structures.description: A large open-surface impoundment (percolation tank) captures runoff from rooftops and open spaces, allowing slow percolation over a large area. Best for large plots and community use.
recommended_structures.installation_notes: Suitable for land area >100m². Depth 1.5–3m. Provide inlet, spillway, and de-silting arrangement. Plant grass on bunds to prevent erosion.
